response.justification: The candidate has extensive software development experience and demonstrates proficiency in C, Linux, and embedded systems. However, they lack direct experience with security features for embedded networking (e.g., MACsec, IEEE 802.1X) and native Japanese proficiency. Their background in web and mobile development does not fully align with the embedded networking security focus required for this role.
strengths: Strong C and Linux kernel experience (National Instruments, Dunnhumby media)
Experience with embedded systems and hardware control (Altom Consulting, National Instruments)
Proven ability to learn new technologies and solve complex problems (AI-agent infrastructure, robotic arms)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with security technologies like MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, or encryption systems
Lacks native Japanese proficiency (only fluent in English and Romanian)
Limited exposure to networking technologies (Layer-2/3, switch operations) as most roles were web/backend-focused
